title: Quantum Foundations in Lean: Finite-Dimensional Formalizations and Typed Premise Audits
description: Final AFM-facing publication release of the Lean 4 / Mathlib finite-dimensional quantum-foundations library. Relative to v1.4.1-afm-audit, this release changes no Lean theorem body. It freezes the cleaned publication-facing README, AFM_ARTIFACT.md reviewer map, exact QuantumFoundations/Audit/AFM.lean declaration audit, one-command verification entry point, and final citation/reproducibility metadata. The mathematical surface includes Wigner and one-directional Uhlhorn--Semrl, projective and effect-perspective Born representation, elementary binary refinements and sharpness witnesses, finite Naimark dilation, and the strict residual-dimension classification of binary implementations. The direct Gleason code dependency remains pinned to v1.1.0-journal-audit at commit 5c5bc40d2e4a31a0d1b3112fcc9a3e92b2000ec5; the AFM-facing Gleason documentation release is v1.1.1-afm-final at commit cd88c1d658eab2a8c47e950025547ae79c8852ce.
